name: Independent reproduction of a candidate
objective: Reproduce a candidate from its record alone and record a verdict with fresh evidence.
preconditions: A candidate finding exists with evidence and an affected asset
steps: Work from the finding record, never from the discovering worker's transcript.
Repeat the observation against the same approved asset and capture new evidence.
Confirm only when the fresh evidence shows the same behavior; reject when it does not; record inconclusive when the evidence is incomplete.
falsePositives: A transient response can look like a fix or a break; prefer inconclusive over a confident wrong verdict.
